test_so3_exp_map_determinant: test that so3_exp_map produces rotation matrices with determinants equal to 1
test_so3_hat_cross_product: test that the hat function matrix product equals the cross product of two vectors
test_so3_exp_log_roundtrip: test that so3_log_map and so3_exp_map are inverses of each other
test_so3_relative_angle: test that so3_relative_angle computes the correct angle between two rotation matrices
test_so3_rotation_angle_cos_bound: test that so3_rotation_angle returns finite gradients when cos_bound is set
